story: On Magnolia Loop this Wednesday afternoon, Gary and Rosa are chatting in the warm 82-degree sunshine when Gary happily accepts Rosa's invitation to her Friday dinner and offers to bring his cornbread. Hal, looking dutiful, reminds Gary that the lighting and speaker mount sketch must show every measurement from the street side before it can be filed, and he says he'll be at the pork dinner too. Meanwhile, Donna is at home checking her pickleball bag, which holds a spare paddle for Gary, the balls, and her ladder notes, all packed for Tuesday. Rosa is pinning up a welcome note on the street bulletin board for the Friday evening dinner.
events: Donna (donna pickleball bag): Check the bag: spare paddle for Gary, balls, and my ladder notes all packed for Tuesday
Rosa (street bulletin board): Pin up a note: Welcome dinner at Rosa's, Friday evening, pork and good plates. Gary, Hal, Donna, all three of you, come hungry.

gary.thought_process: Rosa just invited me to her table Friday with Hal and Donna, and nobody has answered her yet. Hal's busy checking my cart form, and I already handed it over, so no need to repeat myself there. Being asked to dinner is exactly the kind of thing that makes me feel needed, and I'm not about to leave her hanging. I'll say yes, thank her, and offer to bring something so I'm not showing up empty-handed.

parameters.content: Rosa, I'd be honored. Friday evening, count me in, and I'll save the good chair from being argued over. Can I bring something? I make a decent cornbread.

donna.thought_process: I've already booked Tuesday's court slot and texted Gary, and I've flipped through the calendar twice. Checking again won't make him reply any faster. Nobody's around to talk to, so the useful thing is to get my gear in order. Gary's spare paddle is in the bag and I want it ready to hand him next week, so I'll go through the pickleball bag and make sure balls, paddles, and my ladder notes are all set.

parameters.content: Check the bag: spare paddle for Gary, balls, and my ladder notes all packed for Tuesday

hal.thought_process: Gary handed over his cart form and I promised to check it line by line. Rosa is waiting and just invited all of us for Friday pork, which suits me fine. Best to finish Gary's review first so it goes in right, then give Rosa her due. Respond to what was said without re-asking anything. Under L-01, the lights and speaker mounts visible from the street need Architectural Review approval, so I'll tell him the sketch has to show them from the street side and the measurements have to be exact. Then I'll thank Rosa and accept.

parameters.content: Good, you held it back. Since the lights and speaker mounts show from the street, L-01 applies, so the sketch must show them from the street side with every measurement marked. Fix that and it's ready to file. And Rosa's pork Friday suits me fine, I'll be there.

rosa.thought_process: I already asked Gary at tick 348 to come to my Friday dinner and he never answered, he went straight to his form with Hal. I shouldn't repeat the invitation. Hal asked for a minute and the two of them are busy with that paperwork, so I'll be patient. Donna is the third neighbor I still need to lock in, and she's not on the street right now. Rather than hover, I'll post the dinner invitation on the street bulletin board where all three will see it, which also gives Gary an easy way to say yes without being put on the spot.

parameters.content: Pin up a note: Welcome dinner at Rosa's, Friday evening, pork and good plates. Gary, Hal, Donna, all three of you, come hungry.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
